fields.title: buyX
fields.subtitle: Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform
fields.outcome: Migrated a legacy Django monolith to Next.js 15, cutting page-load time and enabling server-side rendering.
fields.description: Dual-sided e-commerce platform for customers and distributors with product browsing, purchasing, inventory management, and order tracking.
details: Migrated legacy Django-based system to Next.js 15 for improved performance and scalability
Built responsive UI using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui component library
Integrated Razorpay for payments and Twilio for OTP/SMS notifications
Designed REST API layer with Prisma ORM and MySQL database

fields.title: Smart Resource Predictor
fields.subtitle: AI-Based Predictive Web App
fields.outcome: Achieved 97% forecast accuracy for energy/water usage; deployed as Flask web app with interactive dashboards.
fields.description: AI-based predictive system using ML models to forecast energy and water usage, exposed via a Flask web application with interactive dashboards.
details: Used Decision Tree, XGBoost, and Neural Networks (TensorFlow) for multi-model ensemble predictions
Developed a Flask web app with Chart.js interactive dashboards
Applied feature engineering and optimisation algorithms for sustainable resource usage forecasting
Stored and queried time-series data in MySQL

fields.title: EDA – E-Commerce Sales
fields.subtitle: Exploratory Data Analysis
fields.outcome: Uncovered top revenue drivers and regional trends across 7,200+ transactions, surfaced in a visual report.
fields.description: In-depth analysis of 7,200+ e-commerce transactions to identify sales, revenue, and customer behaviour trends.
details: Executed data cleaning, preprocessing, and correlation analysis on 7,200+ records
Designed visual dashboards and analytical reports with Matplotlib and Seaborn
Uncovered key performance drivers and regional trends for stakeholder decision-making

fields.title: Top 500 Crypto Coins
fields.subtitle: Power BI Dashboard
fields.outcome: Delivered an interactive ETL + BI dashboard tracking market caps and price trends for 500 cryptocurrencies.
fields.description: Interactive Power BI dashboard to visualise and analyse market trends and performance metrics of the top 500 cryptocurrencies.
details: Extracted, transformed, and loaded (ETL) cryptocurrency market data into Power BI
Designed interactive charts, slicers, and KPIs to track market caps and price trends
Created a comprehensive .pbix file for dynamic, self-service data exploration
